key_insight: Entire sig-jump-diffusions enable expected-signature computation through linear ODEs, providing a tractable foundation for score-based generative modeling.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports generative models for time series and finite-dimensional data by reducing generalized score learning to linear ODE solves and deterministic optimization.
method: Define jump-diffusions whose characteristics depend linearly on potentially infinitely many signature components.
Compute expected signatures via linear ODEs, with finite-dimensional systems for embedded polynomial jump-diffusions.
Learn scores through expected-signature calculations or inverse signature matching.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical reductions and an embedding result for polynomial jump-diffusions, but no datasets, empirical benchmarks, or quantitative performance results.
watch_item: For general entire sig-jump-diffusions, practical implementation may require truncating the infinite-dimensional signature system and controlling approximation error.
paper_title: Entire sig-jump-diffusions, their expected signature and applications to score-based generative modeling
